name: RicingDock
description:
A dock you rice yourself: a floating island or a full-width bar, frosted glass, smooth magnification and every size, color and gap on a slider.

• Island or full width, at the bottom, left or right, aligned left, center or right
• Frosted glass: opacity, blur and blur brightness; rounded corners, border, shadow
• Magnification of the icon under the pointer (or a macOS-like wave), jitter-free, with neighbours making room only when needed
• The active app's icon stays slightly bigger and doesn't react to hover
• Running indicators (dots, pill, line), unread counters and progress (Telegram, Thunderbird, browsers), a bounce on launch and on new messages
• Show Apps button before or after the icons, or pinned to either end
• Drag icons to reorder or pin, drop on Show Apps to unpin
• Hold Super to see 1–9 hints for Super+number
• Always visible, smart hide or auto hide
• Dock height with top and bottom padding (linked or separate), side padding, spacing
• Animation speed, and two ready-made looks: Dark Mint and Dark Glass

Replaces the Ubuntu Dock / Dash to Dock: turn those off to avoid two docks. From the maker of RicingTab.
